difficulty_reason: The Cech-to-derived spectral sequence for a covering f : U -> X satisfying the stated flat lfp hypotheses: the proof opens with the remarks (fibre products exist and each f_p is faithful by lemma-fibre-products-preserve-properties, pullback of an injective is injective by lemma-pullback-injective), builds the double complex C^{p,q}, runs both spectral sequences and closes with Homology, double-complex-gives-resolution. The E_1 identification and convergence are written out. Retained author proof at lines 3623-3669.
